# Ledgerly 4.2 release notes
Releasing October 14

## What's new

- Bank feeds now sync every 15 minutes instead of every hour, so your transactions show up sooner.
- You can now update multiple invoices at once instead of editing them one by one.

## Fixes

- Fixed a bug where currency symbols didn't display correctly in exported PDFs.
